nina: quick FYI — while bringing up novo-16b with hybrid quant (int2+float8) i hit a weird RoPE phase slip right after shard boundary prefetching. reproducer uses 50k ctx, private cluster.

omar: can you share the exact flags and which prefetch mode? sounds like a boundary/align issue.

nina: cmd: `./long_eval --model=novo-16b-hybrid --ctx=51200 --quant=hybrid-int2-fp8 --prefetch=shard-boundary --repeat=8 --kv-trace=rope,shard`

julia: snippet from kvcache trace: 
```
[2026-03-25T14:12:01Z] shard=3 local_pos=29999 ropos=59998 -> ok
[2026-03-25T14:12:02Z] shard=3 local_pos=30000 ropos=60000 -> ok
[2026-03-25T14:12:02Z] shard=3 local_pos=30001 ropos=0 -> WARNING: wrap/alias
[2026-03-25T14:12:02Z] gen: "...she closed the door" -> "she closed the door she closed"  <-- phase slip
```

patrick: 0 ropos after 60000 looks like a modulo mismatch between sharded prefetch and global rotable index. maybe we applied a mask with wrong width when moving from bytes->tokens in the int2 packer.

triage-bot: CI:hybrid-quant/1767776000 started. artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/hybrid-quant/1767776000 (traces, kv dumps, micro-harness).

omar: can you run with `--kv-index-type=uint64 --prefetch=disabled` to confirm prefetch is the trigger? also try `--quant=fp8-only` as control.

nina: running now. quick micro-repro attached to artifacts: s3://redwood-qa/triage/1767776000/micro_repro.sh. initial results: prefetch=on + hybrid -> 5/8 runs show slip; prefetch=off -> 0/8; fp8-only -> 0/8.

julia: good signal. sounds like hybrid packing math when computing token stride across shards. check `pack_stride_tokens` and any bitmasking around `shard_mask`. recent CL 5912 added a `& 0x7FFF` for perf on int2 path — that could clip larger indices.

patrick: i'll bisect CLs touching the int2 packer and the prefetch code. if it's the mask, a short-term fix is to change mask to `& ((1ULL<<16)-1)` or remove it and add a bounds assert.

nina: opened BUG-ML-5033 (novo16b-hybrid-rope-shard-fence) and assigned to @patrick + @omar. marking P0 for private rollout hold. linked artifacts and micro-harness.

omar: i'll prepare a debug build with wider masks and run the CI matrix. also adding a unit test that appends across shard boundaries and checks monotonic rotable indices.

julia: thanks. can we also add a short-mode CI job that runs hybrid quant on a 32k synthetic prompt to catch this earlier?

patrick: yes, adding a short synthetic to long-ctx-smoke and a debug assert `if (ropos < prev_ropos) crash()` in debug builds. will post patch soon.

nina: thanks all 44d — will watch the CI artifacts and update this thread with a repro binary when available.
